mapper.select: WITH svc AS ( SELECT regexp_replace(ri.item_name, '^[^(]*\(|\)$', '', 'g') AS svc_key, ri.item_code, ri.value, ri.unit, ri.status, ri.raw_text, ri.error_text, r.received_at, s.hostname FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id = ri.run_id LEFT JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = r.server_id WHERE ri.category = 'SVC' AND r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (svc_key, item_code) svc_key AS "svcKey", item_code AS "itemCode", value AS "value", unit AS "unit", status AS "status", raw_text AS "rawText", error_text AS "errorText", hostname AS "hostname", to_char(received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "receivedAt" FROM svc ORDER BY svc_key, item_code, received_at DESC

SELECT regexp_replace(ri.item_name, '^[^(]*\(|\)$', '', 'g') AS "svcKey", count(*) AS "total", sum(CASE WHEN ri.status IN ('WARN','CRITICAL','ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "fail" FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id = ri.run_id WHERE ri.category = 'SVC' AND ri.item_code = 'SVC_URL_STATUS' AND r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY 1
SELECT svc_name AS "svcName", url AS "url" FROM pmc_policy_svc_target WHERE use_yn = 'Y'

SELECT to_char(r.received_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "day", count(*) AS "runCnt", count(DISTINCT r.server_id) AS "serverCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "normalCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "warnCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "criticalCnt", sum(CASE WHEN r.overall_status='ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "errorCnt", sum(r.warn_count) AS "warnItems", sum(r.critical_count) AS "criticalItems" FROM pmc_inspection_run r WHERE r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT CAST(r.run_id AS varchar) AS "runId", s.hostname AS "hostname", r.run_type AS "runType", r.overall_status AS "overallStatus", r.item_count AS "itemCount", r.warn_count AS "warnCount", r.critical_count AS "criticalCount", r.error_count AS "errorCount", to_char(r.received_at, 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "receivedAt" FROM pmc_inspection_run r LEFT JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = r.server_id WHERE r.received_at::date = CAST(#{day} AS date) ORDER BY r.received_at DESC

WITH latest AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.server_id) r.server_id, r.overall_status, r.received_at FROM pmc_inspection_run r ORDER BY r.server_id, r.received_at DESC ), ag AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (server_id) server_id, status, last_heartbeat FROM pmc_agent ORDER BY server_id, last_heartbeat DESC NULLS LAST ) SELECT s.hostname AS "hostname", s.service_name AS "serviceName", COALESCE(l.overall_status, 'NA') AS "overallStatus", to_char(l.received_at, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastRun", COALESCE(ag.status, '-') AS "agentStatus", to_char(ag.last_heartbeat, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastHeartbeat", CASE WHEN ag.last_heartbeat IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - ag.last_heartbeat)) / 60)::int END AS "hbAgeMin" FROM pmc_server s LEFT JOIN latest l ON l.server_id = s.server_id LEFT JOIN ag ON ag.server_id = s.server_id WHERE s.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY s.hostname

SELECT DISTINCT s.server_id AS "serverId", s.hostname AS "hostname" FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id = ri.run_id JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id = r.server_id WHERE ri.item_code IN ('OS_CPU_USAGE','OS_MEM_USAGE','OS_DISK_USAGE','OS_SWAP_USAGE','OS_INODE_USAGE') AND r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) ORDER BY s.hostname

SELECT ri.item_code AS "itemCode", ri.value AS "value", ri.unit AS "unit", ri.status AS "status", to_char(COALESCE(ri.collected_at, r.received_at), 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "ts" FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id = ri.run_id WHERE r.server_id = #{serverId} AND ri.item_code IN ('OS_CPU_USAGE','OS_MEM_USAGE','OS_DISK_USAGE','OS_SWAP_USAGE','OS_INODE_USAGE') AND r.received_at >= now() - make_interval(days => #{days}) ORDER BY ri.item_code, COALESCE(ri.collected_at, r.received_at)

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_run WHERE received_at::date = now()::date) AS "runToday", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id WHERE ri.status='CRITICAL' AND r.received_at >= now() - interval '1 day') AS "criticalToday", (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_result_item ri JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=ri.run_id WHERE ri.status='WARN' AND r.received_at >= now() - interval '1 day') AS "warnToday"
